plugins.name: agent-media
plugins.description: Agent-Media — AI video, image and voice for agents, the loose way: you write the prompt, you pick the model (seedance-2.0, seedance-2.5, gpt-image-2, elevenlabs-tts…), you pass reference images. Four tools: generate_video, generate_image, generate_audio, quote. list_models tells you what each model is good for and what it costs. One MCP URL, browser sign-in.
